system.notes:
Giant, red-skinned divine being radiating pure energy. Reincarnated from the universes before this one.

AC 15, HP 59, ATK 3 slam +6 (1d4+3) or 2 cosmic ray, MV near (fly), S +6, D +5, C +5, I +4, W +4, Ch +5, AL L, LV 12

Cosmic Ray. Straight line (5' wide) extending far from pitri. DEX 15+ or 4d6 damage, disintegrated at 0 HP.

Fire Aura. Creatures within near of pitri at start of turn CON 15+ or 2d6 damage.

Great Good. Only damaged by silver or magical sources. Immune to fire.

Incorporeal. In place of attacks, become corporeal or incorporeal. When pitri becomes incorporeal, near- sized blast of energy centered on pitri, CON 15+ or 3d6 damage.

Rebirth. If slain, reborn on the Positive Energy Plane.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
